lab_questions.title: Longest Unique Page Visit Clickstream
lab_questions.description:
A web analytics engine tracks user navigation paths represented as a sequence of single-character page identifiers (e.g., 'abcabcbb'). Analysts want to find the maximum length of a continuous session segment in which the user visited distinct pages without repeating any page.

Read a single string of page identifiers and output the length of the longest contiguous substring containing all unique characters.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
abcabcbb
Expected Output: 3

solution.python:
import sys
s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
seen = {}
left = 0
max_len = 0
for right, ch in enumerate(s):
    if ch in seen and seen[ch] >= left:
        left = seen[ch] + 1
    seen[ch] = right
    max_len = max(max_len, right - left + 1)
print(max_len)
